== Notes ==
* The life steal occurs for every hit, making it especially effective to counter [[Attack#Skills dealing multiple attacks|attack skills that deal multiple attacks]], such as [[Sun and Moon Slash]] and [[Barrage]].
* The life steal occurs ''before'' the damage from the attack is received.
* This hex will end on the target if the caster [[Death|dies]].
